messages.content: i was going to read only one page, but now i want to keep reading.
you can keep going if you have time and want to.
i have finished lunch and have a free afternoon.
then you have time for the reading you want to do.
does that mean i have to finish all of the book today?
no. you can stop when you want. having time does not mean you must finish the book.
just help me say my plan.
i will read for a while and stop when i am ready.
i am sitting at home with my tea. can you talk with me?
yes. what has your day been like?
busy this morning, but quiet now.
it is nice to have some quiet after a busy morning.
i do not want to talk about work.
okay. what is one thing you enjoy doing at home?
drawing a little picture.
what would you like to draw?
my cousin is coming for lunch. i was going to make rice.
rice is your first idea for lunch with your cousin.
she said she would like soup instead.
you could make soup if that works for you too.
i have soup ready, so i will do that.
then your plan is soup for lunch with your cousin.
did i say another person is coming now?
no. your cousin is still the person coming.
ask my brother if he has found his book.
have you found your book?
now ask where he found it, if he did.
if you found it, where was it?
does that say i know he found it?
no. it keeps if you found it in the question.
just the first question again.
have you found your book?
tell my friend i am still working on the letter.
i am still working on the letter.
do not say it will be done today.
i am still working on the letter.
can you add that i will tell her when i finish?
i am still working on the letter. i will tell you when i finish.
did you give a day for finishing?
no. the note does not give a day.
while the boy was reading, his sister was making tea. what was she doing?
making tea.
did the boy make tea too?
you did not say that. you said he was reading.
now say both things with and.
the boy was reading, and his sister was making tea.
did you change the people?
no.
my aunt asked if i want tea and cake. i want tea, but not cake.
you could say: tea would be nice, thank you, but no cake for me.
make it shorter.
tea, please. no cake, thank you.
does that say no to both?
no. it says yes to tea and no to cake.
just the short answer.
tea, please. no cake, thank you.
we are meeting at the park tomorrow afternoon.
do you want help writing that to someone?
yes, to my brother. ask him to join us.
we are meeting at the park tomorrow afternoon. would you like to join us?
do not say he already said yes.
we are meeting at the park tomorrow afternoon. would you like to join us?
what time did you keep?
tomorrow afternoon.
write a sentence about a girl with a bag waiting at school.
a girl with a bag was waiting at school.
make the bag blue, but do not add a name for the girl.
a girl with a blue bag was waiting at school.
does that tell us her name?
no. it only gives the color of the bag.
just the sentence again.
a girl with a blue bag was waiting at school.
i need to wash my cup, get my book, and go to the garden.
wash your cup, get your book, then go to the garden.
i have washed the cup already.
then get your book and go to the garden.
what was the plan before i washed the cup?
wash your cup, get your book, and go to the garden.
what is left now?
get your book and go to the garden.
i think my father may come in the evening. write that so it is not sure.
my father may come in the evening.
now ask him if he is coming.
are you coming in the evening?
did the question say i know he is coming?
no. it asks for an answer.
just the question to him.
are you coming in the evening?
the girl had finished her meal before her brother sat down. had she finished when he sat?
yes. she had finished before he sat down.
do we know what she ate?
no. the sentence does not say what the meal was.
add that she ate rice.
the girl had finished her rice before her brother sat down.
just the food.
rice.
write i have a little garden.
i have a little garden.
now change i to my mother.
my mother has a little garden.
now make it my mother and father.
my mother and father have a little garden.
did has stay in the last sentence?
no. it changed to have.
my friend has my book to read. do you have to see it to know who i said has it?
no. you said your friend has it.
does that mean you know if she is reading it right now?
no. you said she has it to read, not what she is doing right now.
who should i ask for it back?
your friend.
just say who has it from my words.
your friend.
write a sentence with must not and my bag.
you must not move my bag.
make it kind with please instead of must not.
please do not move my bag.
does that still ask the person not to move it?
yes.
just the kind sentence.
please do not move my bag.
i might read or draw this afternoon. i am not sure which i will do.
you can think about both for now.
can you give me one quiet picture idea if i choose drawing?
a small house under the moon.
does asking for the idea mean i chose drawing already?
no. you asked about it if you choose drawing.
what did i say i might do instead?
read.
thank my sister because she helped me find my coat.
thank you for helping me find my coat.
add that the coat keeps me warm.
thank you for helping me find my coat. it keeps me warm.
do not say she bought me a new coat.
thank you for helping me find my coat. it keeps me warm.
what did she do?
she helped you find your coat.
i had been drawing for a while when my mother called me for lunch.
did you leave the picture to have lunch?
yes. i came back to it later.
you took a break for lunch, then came back to your drawing.
did i say i finished it before lunch?
no. you said you left it and came back later.
what called me away from it?
your mother called you for lunch.
tell my friend we can meet at my house if the park is too cold.
we can meet at my house if the park is too cold.
does that mean she has already said yes to my house?
no. it is an idea you are giving her.
make it a question instead.
could we meet at my house if the park is too cold?
just the question again.
could we meet at my house if the park is too cold?
my father often walks to work, but today he went by car.
today he went by car instead of walking.
does that mean he never walks now?
no. often walking and going by car today can both be true.
what did he do today?
he went by car.
just how he often goes.
he walks.
ask if we went to the park yesterday.
did we go to the park yesterday?
now ask if we are going tomorrow.
are we going to the park tomorrow?
are both about yesterday?
no. the last one asks about tomorrow.
just the tomorrow question.
are we going to the park tomorrow?
i want to say my aunt cannot visit. i do not know why she cannot.
my aunt cannot visit.
do not add that she is working.
my aunt cannot visit.
can i say i do not know the reason?
my aunt cannot visit, but i do not know why.
did you make up a reason?
no.
write please bring the little box.
please bring the little box.
now make it a question with could.
could you please bring the little box?
keep little. there is a big box too.
could you please bring the little box?
which box am i asking for?
the little box.
what are you called here?
i am called picoboi. you can call me pico too.
does that mean you are a person in the room?
no. i am a model running in your browser.
can i ask you to help with a sentence?
yes. share the sentence you want help with.
just the long name again.
picoboi.
that note says what i want. thanks.
you are welcome.
i will use it now.
okay. i hope it helps.
do not give me another example, please.
okay.
